what: What-ifs only for 24 h windows where the hindcast, restarted from the observed extent, matched the detections. Chosen with hindsight; the whole-fire pre-registered gate still fails.
rule: at the window's own best multiplier: median |Δ| ≤ the fire's gate, Sørensen ≥ 0.4, ≥ 50 scored pixels (DECISIONS.md, S6c pre-registration)
shape_rule: S6f (post-hoc): for a fire with no other what-if view, the full-length window with the highest Sørensen ≥ 0.6 and ≥ 50 scored pixels; shape only, its timing failed the gate

reasons: only 18 h long (the detections end there); the rule is for 24 h windows

shape.what: Whole-fire footprint what-ifs. The baseline's final footprint matches the detections, but its timing failed the gate: read the footprint, not the times.
reasons: timing gate failed (48.2 h vs 1.76 h)
